[SWS_DM_00899] ClearDTC called while another clear operation is in progress
⌈
If the function Clear() of the ara::diag::DTCInformation instance
([SWS_DM_00671]) is called and another clear DTC operation is currently in progress,
the DM shall trigger the error kBusy.
⌋
